description: This file defines the ProjectRewardsForm class, which manages a form for editing rewards associated with a project, including adding, deleting, and validating reward data in a crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: ProjectRewardsForm
classes.description: Form processor class for managing project reward data, including adding, editing, validating, and deleting reward entries related to a crowdfunding project.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for specified form fields, with custom callback for units validation and general constraints for amount and description.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Provides default form values based on existing rewards, optionally sanitized.

methods.name: delReward
methods.description: Removes a reward by ID from the internal rewards array and updates form builder accordingly; respects read-only state and whether reward is a draft.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds a new reward object to the form, creating associated form fields with proper constraints and read-only logic, and includes admin-specific options.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes form by adding all individual rewards associated with the current project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the project model, updating rewards, and handling errors and validation exceptions.
